platecarrier.name: Tactical Chest Rig
platecarrier.desc: A sand-colored chest rig with magazine pouches and a composite plate over the vitals. Light enough to move in, but it only covers what matters.

tachelmet.name: Tactical Helmet
tachelmet.desc: A helmet that covers the skull, with a pair of goggles clipped to the front. It makes me look like a mercenary.

earplugs.name: Tactical Earplugs
earplugs.desc: Two orange foam plugs. Wear them when you shoot.

blackpack.name: Black Backpack
blackpack.desc: A standard black synthetic backpack. It holds a lot. Nobody designed it for comfort, but it is good enough. It was probably my favorite thing in the lab, which is why they sent it down with me. A grave good, I suppose.

ammobox.name: Ammo Box
ammobox.desc: An olive-drab steel box. It looks old, but what is inside still works.

mdrz9.name: MDRZ9 7.62x51
mdrz9.desc: A .308 bullpup. The one thing worth trusting down here. Apparently it was brought along to be "tested" too. Don't lose it.

mdrz9mag.name: MDRZ9 Magazine (7.62x51)
mdrz9mag.desc: A twenty-round straight magazine, steel-cased .308. Don't leave it on the floor, all right?

mdrz9round.name: 7.62x51 M62
mdrz9round.desc: One round of .308 Winchester, full power. For some reason every round I find is a tracer.

fishboots.name: Black Hard-Rubber Boots
fishboots.desc: Boots pressed from a single piece of black hard rubber, with a fine tread on the sole. Not comfortable, but they last.

fishcoat.name: Grey Windbreaker
fishcoat.desc: A dusty old windbreaker with a thin composite layer at the elbows and shoulders. It wears well.

fishpants.name: Grey-Black Composite Trousers
fishpants.desc: Composite-fiber trousers in grey and black. They resist wear, and they never look dirty.

jammer.name: Jammer
jammer.desc: An emergency jammer of unknown origin. No maker's mark on the shell, only a small stamped number on the bottom: M-114. It can deaden the chip inside a small radius and let a blade finish the last few centimeters. The battery is single-use and matches the key of exactly one layer. Take it to the bottom and you will understand. Miss that layer and it is a piece of plastic.

bloodbag.name: Blood Bag
bloodbag.desc:
A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself.

<color=#E05A5A>⚠ SF-07's blood does not match a standard experiment blood bag. Transfusion causes severe nausea, fever, and rejection. Do not use it on SF-07.</color>

bloodbaghuman.name: Red Blood Bag
bloodbaghuman.desc:
A 0.75L plastic bag with an autoinjector at the end. Injects 375mL on use. Use in the inventory to draw blood from yourself. There are traces of red on it.

<color=#E05A5A>⚠ Even a red blood bag is not a full match for SF-07. Transfusion causes severe nausea, fever, and rejection. Do not use it on SF-07.</color>
